### installFromSource()

```ts
function installFromSource(input): Promise<Response>;
```

Capture an Artifacts Git commit, build its Release, upload it to an Oyster, and
install it, or switch an existing installation to it
([installRelease](#installrelease)). `waitMs` starts with the upload/observation
phase after packing; a supplied caller signal also interrupts packing and
retains its original lifetime.

### installRelease()

```ts
function installRelease(input): Promise<Response>;
```

Upload a packed Release to an Oyster and install it. The host installs a new
installation (201) or switches an existing one to this Release (200), keeping
its state. Uploads precede admission; this helper then waits for the correlated
terminal owner receipt, not merely the HTTP acknowledgement. Uploads and
observation share the caller signal or explicit `waitMs`; absent either, the
installer owns a twenty-minute default. Expiry does not cancel admitted work and
is reported as an unconfirmed observation, not refusal.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `input`   | `Readonly`\<\{ `directory`: `string`; `url`: `string`; `key`: `string`; `installationId?`: `string`; `onAdmitted?`: (`operation`) => `void`; `onCompleted?`: (`operation`) => `Promise`\<`void`\>; \}\> & `Readonly`\<\{ `waitMs?`: `number`; `signal?`: `AbortSignal`; \}\> |

#### Returns

`Promise`\<`Response`\>

### publishSource()

```ts
function publishSource(input): Promise<Response>;
```

Project one exact first-party commit's editable source, `git push` it to an
Oyster's own template for that App, and claim the pushed head, so `APPS.fork`
and Computer builds can later read it. The operator owner key authenticates
both; it reaches Git only through its config environment and no provider
credential ever leaves the Oyster. Answers the claim response:
`{ kind: "recorded" | "existing", receipt }` on success.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `input`   | `Readonly`\<\{ `appId`: `string`; `entry`: `string`; `repositoryPath`: `string`; `sourceRevision`: `string`; `recipe`: [`PackOptions`](#packoptions)\[`"recipe"`\]; `url`: `string`; `key`: `string`; \}\> |

#### Returns

`Promise`\<`Response`\>
